title: Settling How Much Extra Time Is Quoted on a Keyturn Trip Booking Reservation
content:
The extra time quoted for an extension on a Keyturn Trip Booking is taken from an earlier request standing against the reservation where the trip has been running for at least 7 days and such a request is there to be read.

**Where the reservation carries an extension request that expired without a decision and the trip has run for at least 7 days**, the extra time quoted is the extra time that expired request asked for, and where more than one such request stands the one read is the latest of them by the time it was put on the register.

**Where the reservation carries no request that expired without a decision but carries one that was declined, and the trip has run for at least 7 days**, the extra time quoted is the extra time that declined request asked for, and where more than one such request stands the one read is the latest of them by the time it was put on the register, held to the longest further time the reservation can still take.

**In every other case** the extra time quoted is the longest further time the reservation can still take.

The days the trip has run are counted from the day the trip actually started to the day of handling, the day it started not counted and the day of handling counted.

### Which request is read

| Requests standing against the reservation | Days the trip has run | The extra time quoted |
|---|---|---|
| At least one that expired without a decision | 7 or more | The extra time the latest such expired request asked for. |
| None expired, at least one declined | 7 or more | The extra time the latest such declined request asked for, held to the longest further time the reservation can still take. |
| None expired and none declined | 7 or more | The longest further time the reservation can still take. |
| Any | Fewer than 7 | The longest further time the reservation can still take. |

An expired request governs over a declined one. Where several requests of the governing kind stand against the reservation, the one read is the latest of them by the time it was put on the register. Seven days is reached rather than passed.

The holding-down applies to the declined case only: extra time taken from an expired request is quoted as that request asked for it.

*Hypothetical.* A trip running 22 days whose latest expired request asked for 40 hours: the extra time quoted is 40 hours. The same trip with no expired request and a latest declined request asking for 30 hours: the extra time quoted is 30 hours. The same trip with no expired request and a latest declined request asking for 96 hours: that figure is held down to the longest further time the reservation can still take.
